title: Answer: takes no position on life

statements.text: The theory takes no position on life. It marks the mental by intentional and sensory character, in a tradition Rosenthal calls naturalist and Aristotelian, and leaves open whether robots with the right higher-order mechanisms would be aware.

sources.quote: For it is a roughly Aristotelian idea that the mental is somehow dependent on highly organized forms of life
What about robots programmed with the right kind of higher-order and first-order mechanisms?
